plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a government contractor known as SAIC was likely involved in psychotronic or psionic research, meaning research into mind powers and machines that act on the mind. He raises it while discussing the claims of a man named Randy Anderson. If true, it would mean private companies helped the government study the mind as a tool.
